question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Galveston?
answer_short: Yes, with a license plate and a city permit. Galveston allows golf carts and NEVs on streets posted 35 mph or less, except state highways such as Seawall Blvd, Broadway, Harborside Dr and 61st St, the Pelican Island Causeway, and parts of Avenues O and P. You may cross those at intersections.

rules.rule: No golf carts or NEVs where posted over 35 mph, on state highway streets (Seawall Blvd, Broadway, Harborside Dr, 61st St, Ferry Rd, FM 3005, FM 188, I-45, SH 168), the Pelican Island Causeway, Avenue O from 53rd to 15th St, or Avenue P from 19th to 53rd St
Golf carts need a license plate and NEVs state registration, plus an annual city permit and decal after a city-approved inspection
Carts used 103rd St and east also need turn signals, horn, brake lights and seat belts; west-end permits may not drive east of 103rd St
You may cross a banned street, but not drive along it
A registered neighborhood electric vehicle may use roads posted 45 mph or less under state law, but Galveston limits NEVs to streets posted 35 mph or less

banned_roads.name: Ferry Rd, San Luis Pass Rd, Teichman Rd and Fort Point Rd
Avenue O (53rd to 15th St) and Avenue P (19th to 53rd St)

faq.q: Can you drive a golf cart on Seawall Boulevard?
faq.a: No. Seawall Blvd is a state highway street, and Galveston bans golf carts and NEVs on it. You may cross it at an intersection to reach the beach side.

faq.q: Do I need a permit to drive a golf cart in Galveston?
faq.a: Yes. Golf carts need a license plate and NEVs need state registration. Both also need an annual city permit and decal after a city-approved inspection. The private-owner permit fee is $25 a year.
Carts used 103rd St and east need turn signals, a horn, brake lights and seat belts, and riders over age 7 must wear seat belts there. A west-end permit does not allow driving east of 103rd St.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Broadway in Galveston?
faq.a: No. Broadway is part of the state highway system, so Galveston bans golf carts and NEVs on it. Cross it at an intersection instead.
